text_block_list.text:
I spotted Marvelous Sunday and Mayano Top Gun
in the park, seemingly out on roadwork.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, could you help take a picture!
I wanna take one with Mayano by the sparkling marvelous pond!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yay, thank you!
Use Maya's smartphone, please!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Kyah!!

Tripping, the smartphone slipped right out of her hand,
arced through the air, and splashed into the middle of the pond.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No way... Wh-What should I do.
I can't fetch it from inside the pond...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mayano, don't give up just yet!
There's marvelous in this world, so it's all okay☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous will definitely lend us a hand!
Believe in marvelous and make a wish☆ Okay?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Marvelous...? How... do I make a wish...?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Lend us your power~!
Woof-wonderful marve-loous☆★

text_block_list.name: Lots of Dogs
text_block_list.text:
...Woof! Ruff ruff!
Bark bark bark woof! Arf arf arf woof!!

Dogs gathered from all around,
lining up right in front of Marvelous Sunday!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous☆ Thank you all for coming!
Alright, here I go~★

Marvelous Sunday and the dogs
dove into the pond one after another and submerged!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
M-Mave-chin!?
What do we do, she went under!

text_block_list.name: Gray Dog
text_block_list.text: Woof! Bark bark bark!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
...Puhah!
Mayanooo! Found the phone—!!

As one dog barked, Marvelous Sunday
safely poked her head out right from that spot.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Geez Mave-chin, diving into the pond out of nowhere!
You totally startled me~.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
'Cause you looked like you were gonna cry, Mayano!
Hey, are you marvelous now that your phone is back?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah! Thank you, Mave-chin!
Maya feels super-duper marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yay yay~! I'm super marve-loous too☆★

text_block_list.name: Lots of Dogs
text_block_list.text: Woof!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wait, looking closely at these doggies...
They're the ones Mave-chin always greets!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's right! My marvelous friends☆
One of the many marvelous things spread across the world!
They rushed over just for you, Mayano!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I see, so the doggies helped
search for it too.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's why we found it so fast!
I'm so glad your phone didn't break☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's why we found it so fast!
I'm so glad your phone didn't break☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I'll think about it!
Sometimes recklessness leads to marvelous after all!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mayano. Why don't you check
to make sure everything inside your phone is fine?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ah, good idea.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh... wow! There's tons of underwater photos!
Did you take these, Mave-chin?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
It's an extra serving of marvelous☆
Ahahaha★ Ahahahahaha~☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: I'm alri... *achoo*!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah-wah! Mave-chin, aren't you freezing?
We gotta get home and warm up right away!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mayano, your eyebrows are drooping all down.
...Are you super worried about me?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Then we definitely gotta head back quick!
Ahahaha★ Ahahahahaha~☆
Marvelous Sunday and the girl went home together, smiling happily side by side.
